entries.title: Psalms 123:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 123:2
segments: Behold, as the eyes of servants [look] unto the hand of their masters, [and] as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes [wait] upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

entries.title: Psalms 123:3
segments: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

words.text: upon us: for we are exceedingly

entries.title: Psalms 123:4
segments: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, [and] with the contempt of the proud.

words.text: of those that are at ease
